summary: F5, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Anand Eswaran as a director effective April 24, 2026. Mr. Eswaran will serve on the Audit and Talent and Compensation Committees and receive standard non-employee director compensation: $60,000 annual retainer, committee fees ($20,000 Audit, $12,500 Talent/Compensation), and a $275,000 restricted stock unit grant under the 2026 Incentive Award Plan. The filing includes a press release dated April 28, 2026. This is a routine board appointment with no forced departure or activist context. What to watch: none.
